hooks.command: if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED" = 1 ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID" ]; then d="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"; f="$d/ccmorph-session-end.$CLAUDE_PID"; t=$(mktemp "$d/ccmorph-session-end.XXXXXX") || exit 0; { cat > "$t" && ln "$t" "$f.json"; } 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$t"; t=$(mktemp "$d/ccmorph-session-end.XXXXXX") || exit 0; { printf %s "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID" > "$t" && ln "$t" "$f"; } 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$t"; fi; exit 0
